## History

Alec was present when old Mrs. Douglas was dying and summoned [Janet](../character/janet.md) to the Douglas home to be at her bedside. Following Mrs. Douglas's death, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) was finally able to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md) after being bound to secrecy by his mother for nineteen years.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 ch.Home P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 ch.Home P9](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0009), +125 more_

## Relationships

### [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alec and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md) are rivals competing directly for [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's affection and final choice in marriage. Both men maintain a persistent presence as suitors while she deliberates between them. Their dynamic is defined by this ongoing romantic competition for her hand.

- Rival of — rivals for Phil Gordon's affection and marriage choice  <sub>[v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--phil-gordon.md)

Alec is one of the suitors whom [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) is actively considering for marriage. He pursues her affection while she weighs her options between him and his rival. Their relationship is characterized by this unresolved romantic courtship as [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) contemplates her decision.

- Romantically involved with — suitor she is considering marrying  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), +1 more</sub>
